item.title: SQLite Data Types: INT vs INTEGER vs SMALLINT vs TINYINT
item.description:
Understanding SQLite Data Types

When working with SQLite3, comprehending the nuances among data types like INT, INTEGER, SMALLINT, and TINYINT is crucial. In this post, we’ll delve into the differences between these related data types and their implications for your SQLite database.

Understanding SQLite Data Types

SQLite utilizes a manifest typing system, treating all values as text internally. These values are then coerced or converted into various storage locations based on affinities. Refer to the SQLite storage classes reference guide for a detailed understanding.
